headers.//: The SPA rewrite serves index.html for every unmatched path, so this must match the catch-all too - not just the literal file. Without it the rewrite response keeps Firebase's default 1-hour cache and a stale index.html pins the browser to the previous bundle.
Vite emits content-hashed filenames, so these are safe to cache immutably. This rule is listed after the catch-all so it takes precedence for /assets/ requests.
